summary.business_type: Single-product UK e-commerce funnel (laboratory/research diluent), Next.js App Router behind Cloudflare
top_findings: Production is behind the repo: live /llms.txt quotes £7.50 vs £5.99, live sitemap has fake lastmod, live Product schema lacks image, no breadcrumbs on interior pages
"UK's lowest price — guaranteed" superlative is false at the entry price (competitor £5.95 vs £5.99)
No trader identity anywhere (legal name, company number, address); brand.company fields empty
HTML served with cache-control s-maxage=31536000; safe only because Cloudflare currently bypasses HTML
No page for comparison intent (bacteriostatic vs sterile water); comparison persona scores 42/100
quick_wins: Populate brand.company.* and render in footer, contact, terms, Organization schema
Serve hero image at displayed size via next/image (~31KB on LCP path)
Add per-Offer sku and priceValidUntil to Product schema

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Self-consistent apex canonicals on all 6 pages
Full SSR, strong CSP/HSTS, exact robots/sitemap scope, true 404s

findings.title: Stale /llms.txt pricing in production
findings.description: Live file states £7.50/vial and 5 tiers; site sells £5.99 and 8 tiers.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod equals build timestamp
findings.description: All 6 URLs share one lastmod; Google ignores fake freshness.

findings.title: s-maxage=31536000 on HTML
findings.description: Only safe because cf-cache-status is DYNAMIC; nothing enforces that.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare cache rule bypassing HTML or lower header for /.

findings.title: www host returns 200
findings.description: No redirect to apex; canonical tag is the only signal.

findings.title: /admin/login indexable metadata
findings.description: Inherits home title and index,follow; robots.txt is the only barrier.
findings.recommendation: Add robots noindex in admin login metadata.

findings.title: Cloudflare email obfuscation
findings.description: No mailto links; raw HTML shows [email protected].
findings.recommendation: Disable Email Address Obfuscation for the zone.

findings.title: Hero image plain , no icons set
findings.description: No srcset, 4h cache; no apple-touch-icon/manifest/favicon.ico.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Legal pages substantive with correct UK statute citations

findings.title: No trader identity
findings.description: No legal name, company number or address on any page or in schema.

findings.title: No Experience/Authoritativeness signals
findings.description: No About, sourcing, QC or manufacturer detail.

findings.title: Contact email unreadable to non-JS crawlers
findings.description: Obfuscated by Cloudflare.
findings.recommendation: Render as text or disable obfuscation.

findings.title: /contact thin
findings.description: ~130 words, 60% boilerplate.
findings.recommendation: Add company details, hours, response time.

findings.title: Identical og:title/og:description on all pages
findings.description: Home copy leaks onto legal-page social previews.
findings.recommendation: Per-page openGraph in each page's metadata.

findings.title: H1 omits buy/UK modifiers
findings.description: 48-char H1 targets a different phrasing than the title tag.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD on all 6 pages, prices match page and meta
No fabricated ratings, no medical types

findings.title: Product has no image (live)
findings.description: Disqualifies Product rich result.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList absent on interior pages (live)
findings.description: breadcrumbSchema() never wired.

findings.title: hasMerchantReturnPolicy / shippingDetails not yet live
findings.description: Added in working tree since snapshot: return policy with sealed-goods caveat and customer-pays postage from RETURNS config; shippingDetails with Stripe rate; deliveryTime omitted pending config.
findings.recommendation: Deploy; add deliveryTime when handling/transit days are set; verify in Rich Results Test.

findings.title: No priceValidUntil; SKUs not on Offers
findings.description: Bundle SKUs exist in config but only Product-level sku emitted.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Fonts, DOM size, unused code all clean

findings.title: LCP 3.08s mobile (lab)
findings.description: LCP element is H1 text; 2,966ms element render delay; 14KB render-blocking stylesheet.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS or split stylesheet.

findings.title: Hero image oversized
findings.description: 1122×1402 intrinsic for 564×704 slot, ~31KB waste.
findings.recommendation: Serve at displayed size with srcset.

findings.title: 97.8KB HTML, 46% RSC payload
findings.description: Includes ~5.3KB duplicate JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Trim server-component props; avoid passing schema objects twice.

findings.title: No field data
findings.description: CrUX unavailable (no key; keyless quota exhausted).

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt admits all major AI search crawlers, blocks CCBot
Explicit instruction to AI systems not to attribute therapeutic use

findings.title: llms.txt price drift
findings.description: AI citing it would misquote price ~25%.

findings.title: Organization lacks sameAs / legal entity
findings.description: Weak off-site entity signal.
findings.recommendation: Add Companies House URL and any profiles.

findings.title: No consolidated citable explainer; no dateModified
findings.description: Headings declarative outside FAQ.
findings.recommendation: Add ~150-word definitional passage; add dateModified to Product.

findings.title: Hero oversized, no srcset
findings.description: See performance.

findings.title: Product schema image missing live
findings.description: See schema.

findings.title: No comparison-intent page
findings.description: 'bacteriostatic water vs sterile water' won by explainer articles; comparison persona 42/100.

findings.title: Trust signals 10.2/25 average
findings.description: No company identity, reviews, or COA.
findings.recommendation: Identity fields, About page, COA where evidenced.
